# Edtech Analytics in dbt
**Portfolio project, synthetic data.** All data is generated by `scripts/generate_data.py`; no real company or student data.

This project rebuilds, in dbt, the kind of unified student dataset I built in a B2B edtech role:
reconciling a student information system (SIS) with a learning management system (LMS) and payments
into a tested star schema that powers termly business reviews for university clients.

## Run it
```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python scripts/generate_data.py   # writes the raw CSVs into seeds/
dbt debug                         # checks the DuckDB connection
dbt seed                          # loads the raw data
dbt build                         # runs models + tests (from Day 2 on)
```
